description: This file declares utility functions for applying Python functions to PyTorch tensors, such as apply_, map_, and map2_.
external_methods: at::Tensor& map_(const at::Tensor&, const at::Tensor&, PyObject*)
at::Tensor& map2_(const at::Tensor&, const at::Tensor&, const at::Tensor&, PyObject*)

methods.name: apply_
methods.description: Applies a Python function to a tensor and returns the result.

methods.name: map_
methods.description: Applies a Python function element-wise to two tensors and returns the result.

methods.name: map2_
methods.description: Applies a Python function to three tensors in a pairwise fashion.
